description.text: A special Scarlet & Violet set released on 26 January 2024 with 245 cards, more than 100 of them Shiny Pokémon: the first Shiny cards of Paldea's Pokémon, led by a Shiny Pikachu, with Tinkaton, Ceruledge and Dondozo. It is the third "Fates" set, after Hidden Fates and Shining Fates, and has Great Tusk ex and Iron Treads ex, Shiny Tera Charizard, Forretress and Espathra ex, and six hyper rares. It was sold in Elite Trainer Boxes, tins, collections and booster bundles.

description.text: A cosmos holofoil copy from the Charizard ex Special Collection. Planned for 11 April 2025 and delayed to 27 June 2025, it held a Charizard ex promo, a jumbo lenticular card, foil copies of Charmander and Charmeleon from Paldean Fates, and five booster packs. It isn't found in booster packs.

description.text: This Special Illustration Rare by USGMEN, showing a Shiny Mew, is one of two new Shiny Mew ex in Paldean Fates, beside a Shiny Ultra Rare by aky CG Works, both first printed in Japan's Shiny Treasure ex. In Simplified Chinese the same art came only in packs of 惊 (Surprise), the third wave of Collect 151, on sale from 18 July 2025.
